svg.title: AuraProj daily change reference for 2026-07-28
svg.desc: Graph editor launcher and companion server.
svg.text: 2026-07-28 - Graph editor launcher and server
main | 2 commits: a931d41, 5d06db9
Daily job
Make AuraAbilityGraph usable as an editor tool without changing runtime ownership.
Web UI/server support, definition metadata serving, native launcher, startup, and build support were added.
BEFORE
Runtime without editor bridge
Graph runtime existed but authoring access
was not surfaced as a tool workflow.
No companion launcher/server path.
Definitions were harder to inspect and edit.
AFTER
Launcher bridges Unreal and the graph web UI
Graph editor UI/server serves definitions and node metadata.
AuraAbilityGraphLauncher starts the companion editor process.
Startup/build support layers on top of the runtime graph module.
Runtime execution remains inside Unreal and the plugin.
Guard: launcher is an authoring bridge, not a second gameplay runtime.
Important guard
Separate editor/server transport from
in-engine task execution and registration.
Both sides need compatible definitions.
Validation / newcomer path
Start at AuraAbilityGraphLauncher, then the web
server, then the Unreal runtime module.
The launcher does not own ability execution.
